description: This file defines the AbstractRelationship class, which is a core component used within SuiteCRM to manage metadata and configurations for various types of relationships between modules. It includes methods for constructing relationship metadata, managing relationship properties, and generating UI components related to relationships.

classes.name: AbstractRelationship
classes.description: An abstract class that provides mechanisms to define, manipulate, and generate metadata for module relationships in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new relationship instance with metadata provided in the definition array.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the unique name of the relationship.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the relationship.

methods.name: readonly
methods.description: Checks if the relationship is read-only.

methods.name: setReadonly
methods.description: Sets the relationship as read-only.

methods.name: setFromStudio
methods.description: Marks the relationship as defined from Studio.

methods.name: deleted
methods.description: Checks if the relationship has been marked as deleted.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Marks the relationship as deleted.

methods.name: getFromStudio
methods.description: Returns whether the relationship was created via Studio.

methods.name: getLhsModule
methods.description: Returns the left-hand module of the relationship.

methods.name: getRhsModule
methods.description: Returns the right-hand module of the relationship.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the relationship type.

methods.name: relationship_only
methods.description: Checks if this relationship should only be used for data, not UI.

methods.name: setRelationship_only
methods.description: Marks the relationship as relationship-only (no UI components).

methods.name: getDefinition
methods.description: Returns the complete metadata definition of the relationship.

methods.name: buildLabels
methods.description: Constructs label metadata for the relationship’s UI components.

methods.name: getLeftModuleSystemLabel
methods.description: Returns the system label for the left module in the relationship.

methods.name: getRightModuleSystemLabel
methods.description: Returns the system label for the right module in the relationship.

methods.name: getLabels
methods.description: Returns a set of labels used in the relationship for UI purposes.

methods.name: getSubpanelDefinition
methods.description: Generates subpanel configuration for the relationship.

methods.name: getLinkFieldDefinition
methods.description: Creates vardef for a link field used in views and relationships.

methods.name: getLink2FieldDefinition
methods.description: Creates vardef for a secondary link field for relationship UI.

methods.name: getRelateFieldDefinition
methods.description: Builds vardef for a relate field used in relationship UI and metadata.

methods.name: getRelationshipMetaData
methods.description: Generates metadata array for defining the relationship in database schema and metadata files.

methods.name: getActivitiesSubModuleRelationshipName
methods.description: Builds standardized relationship name for submodules like Tasks.

methods.name: getValidDBName
methods.description: Sanitizes and constrains names to valid database identifier lengths.

methods.name: parseRelationshipType
methods.description: Converts various relationship type naming variants into canonical constants.

methods.name: getJoinKeyLHS
methods.description: Returns the join key name for the left-hand side module.

methods.name: getJoinKeyRHS
methods.description: Returns the join key name for the right-hand side module.

methods.name: getIDName
methods.description: Returns the ID field name for linking in relationships.

methods.name: getTablename
methods.description: Returns the database table name for a given module.

methods.name: getTitleKey
methods.description: Generates a title label key for the relationship.
